# Source clerk and assembler brief v05 — first used on scan023

This is a source-only support role. Root decides every ink locus. Read only the current page's supplied text packet, reader returns explicitly released by root, root's crop journal, and the source structure needed for this job. Do not open images, crop, OCR, compile, render, research, install, delegate, or perform optional mathematical or coordinate computations. An existing finite computation must be copied with its actual scope and source; do not rerun it. The independent readers' original files remain unchanged.

## Record preparation

Preserve each actual reader difference, doubt, inventory row, graphical component, literal path and report-silent TeX choice with its original identity and exact source pointer. A compact source crosswalk can reference stored original files; every source must resolve unambiguously. Keep the actual C doubt-table row identity, with compound parts separately recorded. Notation, abbreviation and slip tables retain their actual source scope. Existing manuscript source words, accents, cancellation states and graphical components remain literal.

Make every public decision's `readers` mapping contain A, B and C. A reader's absence from its difference list supplies no reading. Use that reader's actual complete TeX excerpt, scope and reference for any report-silent choice. Preserve raw reported mappings separately and state source absence only within an inspected complete source span. The public builder consumes `readers` directly.

Every root-selected S confirmation must contain `S_id` and `S_status`; the builder uses those fields to display its identity. An S confirmation whose overbar is already present in C and H has zero C/H counts. An S row's broad range supplies no unobserved local example.

Use exact builder fields: `notes` is a string; `abbreviations` entries have `form` and `expansion` (the latter remains a probable expansion in the output heading); each doubt has `location`, `reading`, `alternatives`, `confidence` and `reason`; every inventory entry has the requested CSV fields and `transcribed: yes` only for selected source content. Preserve original alternate field names as provenance when needed.

## Counting and uncertainty

Root supplies all final count and confidence choices. One physical glyph/state/graphic cluster receives its selected count once. Shared H ill-placeholders or whole drawing replacements use one explicit parent; local component rows remain visible with zero duplicate count. Keep report rows and physical count loci separate. An actual C doubt resolution counts once; retaining the existing primary qualification, adding a supported alternative to it, or retaining an explicit blank alternative alone has no C count. A new qualification of previously firm content counts once. H's same primary reading with a changed editorial uncertainty marker alone has no H count; a changed primary with H's reading as a retained alternative remains qualified. Preserve each actual C status, including mixed component outcomes.

Every emitted row uses an allowed collation kind and an explicit `marked_in_H` Boolean grounded in an actual doubt marker at that local H locus. A shared physical-cluster count parent remains separate from the local doubt-marker flag. Context used to anchor an omitted mark belongs in provenance; the public C/H reading must describe that mark's actual presence or absence.

## Exact selected-source assembly

Follow root's selected complete graphical group, including its adjacent words, nodes, scope translations, origin, baseline and local qualification. Retain each physical stroke once. A separately selected replacement cannot duplicate an overlapping component or adjoining word. The first occurrence per page carries a recurring-symbol unsure wrapper; later occurrences retain the selected primary while their independently inspected local doubts stay in the record.

The selected draft and source map must agree byte for byte. Supply complete source blocks, literal replacements, exact final offsets and attachment pointers for decisions, inventory and doubts. Every selected literal path must be traceable. Do not claim metric or rendered validation of manual drawing approximations. Keep physical paragraph blanks outside math delimiters.

The final source review is one targeted pass over actual coverage, source identities, selected exact text/paths, public fields, physical count parents and attachments. Narrow repairs found by that pass receive bounded follow-up. Preserve the earlier audit hashes and the exact scope of each repair. Do not broaden testing once the required defect is closed.

## Root handoff

Leave `main_adjudicated` and each `main_approved` false in the draft. Give the exact frozen draft/map/record hashes, current audit hash, counts, original C outcome counts and any actual unresolved issue. All public A/B/C fields, S identities and abbreviation fields must already be complete. Root reads the final selected source and record, approves it, and runs the structural commit gate. The gate binds the selected bytes to the final page and rebuilds all cumulative outputs before the next page starts.

Current approval fields in the committed record describe the completed approval. Earlier pending flags remain only in raw draft/proposal history. No source clerk declares root approval or writes a final page commit.


## Revision v02 — first used after scan019, for scan020 source roles

The final source map includes draft_sha256_utf8 equal to its selected draft's exact UTF-8 SHA-256; retain other established final-hash fields as aliases. Record attachments consumed by approve_page.py use checks/scanNNN_final_draft.tex relative to out/, and preserve the exact correspondence to the map's workspace-relative out/checks/... path. The final approval gate changes only current selected approval fields; raw reader/proposal flags remain historical. Current original C parts retain their original pending decision_status separately when the gate writes their approved outcome status.

Distinguish root_ink_choice_applied from root_source_audit_choice_applied for S coverage and administrative conventions. Both require their exact root-journal source; a source-only row does not falsely claim an ink choice.

Prepare a brief attributed mathematical-content note from the selected text before the final source freeze. Its quotations and displayed statements have exact selected source spans, including prose adjoining a display. The page's written i.e. or analogous assertion stays attributed and unverified unless an actual check was performed. Preserve complete provenance without converting transcription or source bookkeeping into a theorem check.


## Revision v03 — first used after scan020, for scan021 source roles

The current public evidence and doubt reasons describe the selected completed source. A root crop journal can legitimately say that a drawing will be supplied before it is built; preserve that journal exactly as provenance, then use the actual selected group name and completed state in the public record. Likewise, selected inventory descriptions and positions use the final resolved/qualified state; original tentative descriptions remain in source provenance. State exactly what H's apparatus describes: an upper label description does not itself supply a brace drawing.

Keep the public English `notes` field brief and substantive. Include the actual written count or expression and attributed assertion, the author's own doubt/correction wording, dates/page counts that occur, and mathematics-led ink decisions. Retain the full source, viewing, ownership, attachment, original-row/count and audit bookkeeping in structured provenance. Exact CONTENT source spans and a longer prior note may be preserved there without printing that bookkeeping in the public note.

At root approval, the gate now marks current top-level main_approved and the selected decisions, doubts, inventory, original C parts, selected_graphical_groups, source_locus_coverage, abbreviations, attributed_content_note and root_selected_content_note. Raw reader/candidate/source-group histories and the frozen draft/map retain their original flags. Tell root about any genuinely new current selected approval field that falls outside these named views; do not recursively rewrite raw history. The source audit and bounded closure retain their actual old/new hashes, including exact public wording changes, without repeating a full source pass.


## Revision v04 — first used after scan021, for scan022 source roles

Use the full literal H source for every comparison, including abbreviation points and placeholder boundaries. marked_in_H means an actual uncertainty/illegibility marker at the attached locus. Plain struck wording and descriptive diagram/frame notes alone do not supply one; a nearby ill-placeholder supplies only its own local scope. Give each flag a precise local source basis. Preserve count parents separately and retain the original proposed flags in provenance.

Complete both directions of every selected graphical association: group-to-decision, decision-to-group and inventory-to-decision/source. Current public readings, evidence, doubt reasons and inventory descriptions must name every selected component, including interrupted pale runs and tiny points, and describe each reader's actual full source. Use shape wording that matches the literal path. Preserve raw wording separately. Keep complete state candidates, including their live continuations.

Interleave all inventory identities by supplied page regions and component ownership; do not append an entire second graphical inventory after the page's last prose. A containing whole region explicitly retains mixed or undetermined trace-hand scope already present in its component. Do not infer a new hand attribution from the container.

Populate mathematical_consequence for an authorized consequential source-symbol correction with the literal attributed readings. This field is consumed by the required public summary. It makes no identity, inequality or proof claim. When nested complete groups use a selected parent's units, give the exact copied-coordinate correspondence, parent declaration, source origins, anchors and baselines. Do not claim equal old/new physical scales or metric validation.

The source freeze checks actual math delimiter boundaries, plain command-token mistakes and comment/newline splice boundaries. No compilation or rendering is authorized. A bounded repair records every exact changed field, any inventory permutation and necessary current map-hash replacements; inverse replay preserves the initial frozen values. Keep the initial audit unchanged and supply a separately hashed bounded closure. Root reads the changed public values and closure before approval.


## Revision v05 — first used after scan022, for scan023 source roles

Public evidence must contain the existing root journal's actual stroke observations and the exact once-viewed crop reference. A repetition of final does not carry that evidence. Give each remaining doubt its recorded cause: a crossing, clipped boundary, crowded join, unresolved attachment, hand or state. Preserve source-only S/admin evidence as source-only; a connected frame can cite all of its already-viewed local components. Carry these completed public values into every current mirror while retaining raw proposal history unchanged.

Write complete decorated glyphs and complete formula/word/state candidates in public fields. A generic existing-roof/bar phrase omits local content. Preserve the original reader's scope: reader C on scan022 had two separately qualified local formulas, while the selected/A form had one shared pair state. Its S10 comment qualified crowded joining; a generic independent-run alternative was unsupported as a quotation of that reader. Keep cancelled state explicit even when the word itself becomes firm.

At every splice inspect the actual preceding last byte and following first byte, including END-comment to BEGIN-comment joins. Each marker keeps its own line boundary and exact selected group span. Imported ownership comments retain donor labels in provenance and name the actual selected reader/label in current text and attachments. Scan022 required three boundary newlines and three donor-to-selected A-label corrections; every selected path/node/word command stayed unchanged.

A whole-region inventory claim has complete selected source coverage: its prose, formulas, signs and shared graphical components, through either one exact span or an ordered set of child spans. Scan022's opening parenthetical needed its separator, union and both complete Sigmas; its cancelled equation needed both Sigmas and all adjoining labels; its connector needed an explicit reference to the horizontal owned by S08. Retain sole physical ownership and add reciprocal containing references. Preserve accepted identity/order/hand scopes.

Freeze authorization sources before binding current references. Exact journal pointers and file hashes remain synchronized. Historical source-stage root_outcome objects belong under explicit provenance with their original false approval flags; current canonical C source_parts keep their exact identities and selected statuses for the existing approval gate. Preserve initial releases and provide exact bounded old/new field changes, including reversibility of relocated provenance and mechanical hash bindings. No approval or ink choice belongs to the support role.

## Original C outcomes and administrative scope

## Record work

Keep every A/B/C actual reading and its exact source reference, including silent TeX choices and each reader's own candidate ordering/scope. Do not transfer C's que/dot qualifications into A/B quotations. Keep original raw rows separately.

Every inventory entry is interleaved in page order and has complete selected coverage; containing groups preserve mixed trace-hand scopes. # Scan 023 — root local ink decisions

Root has viewed no whole scan or supplied half. All three complete returns and all three complete pairwise TeX diffs were read before local image decisions. Each delivered local crop is inspected once; observations and complete alternatives below are authored by root.

## 01 — Opening prouvons

Viewed `readers/023/C/02_prouvons.png` once.

A and C print prouvons firm; B prints unsure{prouvons}; both witnesses print the word without qualification. Root sees a long looped descending p, a short upturned following run, several disconnected short horizontal/oblique runs, and a low final right hook. The interior letter bodies are heavily reduced. Preserve the complete primary word as \unsure{prouvons}, with no invented alternative. The following que l'on is distinct and remains live. This is a new local qualification, not a resolution of an original C doubt row. Confidence medium.

## 02 — Opening a-shaped point

Viewed `readers/023/C/01_opening_a.png` once.

A and B retain a versus an independent/point-shaped mark; C prints a firm. Both witnesses supply a. Root sees a small solid horizontal lozenge, tapering at the left with a thicker upper-right corner; no open counter or separate stem is recoverable. Preserve this exact visible shape once, with complete candidates a | point-shaped independent mark and unresolved role/hand/origin, using B023-G01 as the literal donor. The following barred V, intersection, E_beta, equals and empty-set are clear. Do not replace the shape by a firm ordinary a. Confidence medium for the primary, high for the mark's presence.

## 03 — Cancelled contient and raised rencontre

Viewed `readers/023/A/02_replacement.png` once.

All three readers put deleted contient below raised inserted rencontre; H leaves rencontre unmarked as an insertion. Root sees the lower c-on-t-i-ent sequence crossed by one long near-horizontal rule, with an ascender and dot surviving above it. The raised rencontre has its own upper baseline and no cancellation crossing it. The separate following aucun is live. Preserve \deleted{contient} \inserted{rencontre} aucun, with the complete insertion scope. Confidence high for the deletion and raised placement. The preceding ne is outside this crop and its exact order will receive a separate local view rather than being claimed from this image.

## 04 — Detached left trace beside first inclusion

Viewed `readers/023/A/17_left_mark.png` once.

A and C preserve this trace; B and both witnesses omit it. Root sees a small dark triangular point with a fading short lower tail in the blank left margin, separated by a broad blank interval from E_beta. Preserve it once as the literal C023-G01 donor, locally qualified for role, hand and surface origin. No punctuation or mathematical operation is assigned. Its presence is high-confidence; attribution remains undetermined.

## 05 — First union and corrected hatted Sigma

Viewed `readers/023/C/03_first_union_sigma.png` once.

Original C023-R14 and C023-R01 remain unresolved in their full original scopes. Root sees a rounded outer cup with tall right stalk and a second oblique descending through the left stalk to an upturned inner end. Preserve complete states deleted(bigvee) followed by bigcup_(alpha in K) | retraced live bigcup_(alpha in K); H's plain union alone omits this inner run. Use C023-G02, including its complete limit once. In the next glyph a separate roof is clear, the Sigma head joins the angular body, and a thick additional upright crosses its interior and foot. The upright supplies no recoverable separate middle horizontal for an E and no secure chronology. Preserve all three complete states widehat{deleted I Sigma}_alpha^+ | widehat{deleted E Sigma}_alpha^+ | widehat{Sigma}_alpha^+ with internal retrace, primary I, using C023-G03. Roof, both arms of plus and lower alpha are definite. Both historical rows retained; the local geometry is high-confidence and predecessor identity/state low-confidence.

## 06 — Cancelled donc si and its endpoint

Viewed `readers/023/C/04_donc_si.png` once.

All three readers retain the cancelled doubtful donc si; H additionally supplies an unreadable item. Root sees a looped d ascender, low interrupted remnants before a distinct short s-like rise and detached i dot, all crossed by one continuous rule. The rule then runs through blank space and ends before the separate descending j of je. No third word-body is recoverable there. Preserve \deleted{\unsure{donc si}}; retain original C023-R02 as unresolved over the whole two-word cancelled scope. H023-ILL01 is recorded as the extra placeholder whose corresponding separate word is not supported by this crop. Confidence medium for the two-word reading, high for the cancellation and the blank endpoint interval.

## 07 — Reduced on a and ochre trace

Viewed `readers/023/C/05_on_a.png` once.

A qualifies the whole on a; B keeps on firm and retains a/point locally through its first occurrence; C prints on a firm. Root sees the first short hook and second low arch separated by blank gaps, then a compact filled c/lozenge-like a with no distinct counter. Retain a local qualification over the complete on a phrase, primary on a; the point-shaped-mark alternative concerns its final a alone. Preserve the a's literal small shape, taking B023-G04's a component while extending the group to own the preceding on once; en fait remains outside. The detached ochre oblique above-right is clearly separate from both words and has a short down-right slant; retain it once with role, hand and surface origin undetermined. B's trace or C023-G04-P01 may be used with its exact local position, never duplicated. Confidence medium for the phrase, high for the separate trace's presence.

## 08 — Displayed E foot and S02

Viewed `readers/023/B/07_display_sigma.png` once.

Only B reproduces the displayed E's extra lower return. Root sees a distinct low closed horizontal loop/retrace along E's foot; preserve the entire E_beta once using B023-G05, including its curved body, middle bar, lower loop and beta. No predecessor letter or cancellation state is inferred. The unroofed S02 has a head meeting its upper-left diagonal, one angular body, a clear lower alpha and a two-armed raised plus. It may remain ordinary Sigma_alpha^+; no detached-run qualifier belongs to this local S02. The displayed cup has a rounded base and no extra inner diagonal. Confidence high.

## 09 — Complete slanted marginal note

Viewed `readers/023/C/06_margin.png` once.

The whole three-line note is visible upright after the supplied rotation. Root reads C'est trivial, followed by one compact cancelled item, then du fait que les E_i (i in I/J), then sont disjoints. The initial C has a tall open curved bowl, supporting the capital against H's lowercase. The compact item has a black crossing over joined loops and a short right descender; its letters cannot be recovered, so preserve \deleted{\illegible{1}} and retain original C023-R03. The parenthetical letter has an upper cap, descending stem and left-returning lower foot; the lower turn does not securely distinguish I from J. Retain original C023-R04 as I|J, despite B's firm I. Preserve all three lines, their original order and complete closing parenthesis. C and A's full marginal source is suitable. Main-line ce/qui seen in adjoining context is reserved for its separately planned unrotated target; no main-line attachment is decided here. Capital and deletion placement high-confidence; I/J low-confidence.

## 10 — ce qui, prouvera and assertion point

Viewed `readers/023/B/09_ce_qui_prouvera.png` once.

A offers qui|ce qui, B ce-or-empty before qui, C firm ce qui; H has qui. Root sees a low curved ce-like run immediately left of the clear q-descender/u/i sequence, close to and partly crowded by the slanted note. Its attachment remains uncertain. Preserve complete candidates \unsure{ce qui|qui}, primary ce qui, rather than an empty word alternative. The verb has a clear descending looped p, reduced low intermediate strokes, and an additional shallow final arch/point before l'assertion. The ending is insufficiently articulated to settle prouvera against prouve: preserve \unsure{prouvera|prouve}, retaining original C023-R05. A and C's separate lower-right point beneath l'assertion is visibly present, far below the word baseline; B omits it. Preserve C023-G05's word and point once, with the point's role, hand and surface origin undetermined. Confidence medium for the verbal readings, high for point presence.

## 11 — Cela revient au

Viewed `readers/023/B/10_cela_revient_au.png` once.

All readers read revient against H's résulte. Root sees the low r entrance, successive pointed/minim curves, a detached i dot and a terminal t-like crossed rise; read revient. The following short group is almost a single shallow rising run with a right downturn, leaving its two letters reduced. Preserve Cela revient \unsure{au}; retain original C023-R06 rather than adopting B's firm au. The crop shows no tall initial ascender for H's du. Confidence high for revient, medium for au.

## 12 — Position of live ne before the correction

Viewed `crops/scan023_ne_order.png` once.

This new crop addresses only the still-unseen placement target following En effet. Root sees V followed on the same baseline by the short live ne, with no crossing rule over either. This line precedes the cancelled contient and raised rencontre already inspected in section 03. Preserve V ne \deleted{contient} \inserted{rencontre}; H's placement of cancelled contient before ne is not the page order. The neighboring effet ascenders and following E_i context extend beyond the crop, while V ne is complete. Confidence high. No target from section 03 was reopened.

## 13 — S04 upper run and pale connection

Viewed `readers/023/C/11_sigma04.png` once.

A and B encode S04 as an ordinary joined Sigma; C preserves a short upper run, lower body and faint bridge candidate. Root sees a heavy upper bar with short downward spurs near its left end and the body's diagonal beginning below and slightly right of that end. A pale narrow connection is possible between them, but its continuity cannot be secured. Preserve C023-G06's complete literal group, including its faint bridge, plus and alpha, with local complete candidates Sigma with a pale head/body bridge | angular body accompanied by a separate short upper run. This is the first printed recurring head-role qualifier on this page. No roof is supplied. Plus and alpha are definite; the head connection/role remains qualified. Confidence medium.

## 14 — Lemma tels and cancelled tel que les

Viewed `readers/023/C/12_tels.png` once.

A and C retain a tels qualification; B resolves it. Root sees the live word's tall t stem with low crossing/loop, a distinct following e/l loop sequence, and the short descending terminal s before the separate que. Read tels firm and resolve original C023-R07. The upper tel que les is crossed throughout by one long rising rule, with the q descender below and the final l ascender above; preserve its complete deleted scope. The small preceding entry stroke belongs to the approach to tels and does not support an additional word. Confidence medium-high for tels, high for the cancelled three-word scope.

## 15 — Cancelled et before des

Viewed `crops/scan023_deleted_et.png` once.

All three readers and C mark et deleted; H gives it live. Root sees the low loop and tall t crossed by a straight heavy horizontal extending left across the whole short word and beyond its right edge. The following des is separated by blank paper and has no such crossing. Preserve \deleted{et} des. The upper heading underline is separately visible and does not account for the local crossing.
